member.summary:
✅ v8.12: STREAM COPY - Exact duration via segment selection
HOW IT WORKS: 1. Each segment = 0.25s = 15 frames (at 60fps) 2. Calculate exact segments needed: 30s / 0.25s = 120 segments 3. Select 120 segments from buffer end (most recent) 4. Concat with -c copy (NO re-encoding!)
RESULT: - Duration: EXACT (30s = 120 segments × 0.25s) - Quality: SAME AS BUFFER (no re-encoding) - Speed: VERY FAST (~0.5s)
